power.name: Power
power.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit.
power.behindText: Each hit that lands builds a short damage bonus.
power.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life.

poison.name: Poison
poison.about: The word of venom. A slow death.
poison.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons. Poison stacks.

frost.name: Frost
frost.behindText: Passes through, hits softer, leaves ice that slows.
frost.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you.

fire.name: Flame
fire.frontText: Fire damage. Explodes and sets enemies burning.
fire.behindText: Passes through, hits softer, leaves burning ground.
fire.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.frontText: Lightning damage. Arcs to nearby enemies.
lightning.behindText: Passes through, hits softer, leaves a storm that strikes.
lightning.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you.

swift.name: Swift
swift.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.about: The word of weight. Slow, and crushing.
heavy.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns.
heavy.behindText: Leaves cracked ground that staggers enemies.

twin.name: Twin
twin.about: The word of doubling. Two of a thing, each the weaker for it.
twin.frontText: Strikes, fires or bursts twice, each time weaker.
twin.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, weaker.

leech.name: Leech
leech.about: The word of hunger. It takes life from what it touches.
leech.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit.
leech.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs.

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.about: The word of ruin. Things burst.
volatile.behindText: Leaves a rune that detonates a moment later.

precise.name: Precise
precise.about: The word of the exact. Narrow, and deadly.
precise.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical.
precise.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour.

frenzied.name: Frenzied
frenzied.about: The word of rage. Faster, and faster.
frenzied.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times.
frenzied.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt.

guarding.name: Guarding
guarding.about: The word of the shield. It keeps you.
guarding.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield.
guarding.behindText: Leaves a ward circle: you take less damage inside it.
guarding.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage.

lasting.name: Lasting
lasting.about: The word of the long hour. What it makes, stays.
lasting.frontText: Everything it makes and gives lasts half again as long.
lasting.behindText: Everything it makes and gives lasts half again as long.
lasting.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you.

fleeting.name: Fleeting
fleeting.about: The word of the moment. All of it, sooner.
fleeting.frontText: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter, and does as much in that time.
fleeting.behindText: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter, and does as much in that time.
fleeting.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster.

vast.name: Vast
vast.about: The word of the wide. Broad, and lighter.
vast.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage.
vast.behindText: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits.

pulling.name: Pulling
pulling.about: The word of the drawing in. Everything comes to it.
pulling.frontText: Drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck.
pulling.behindText: Leaves a vortex that keeps drawing enemies in.
pulling.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it.

splitting.name: Splitting
splitting.about: The word of the breaking apart. One becomes many.
splitting.frontText: Breaks into three smaller copies that fly on to other enemies.
splitting.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out in every direction.
splitting.monsterText: Splits in two when it dies.

hexing.name: Hexing
hexing.about: The word of the curse. What it marks is undone.
hexing.frontText: Curses what it hits: it takes more damage from everything.
hexing.behindText: Leaves a hex circle: enemies inside deal less damage.
hexing.monsterText: Its blows curse you: you take more damage.

stilling.name: Stilling
stilling.about: The word of the held breath. Time slows for it.
stilling.frontText: What it hits is slowed in time.
stilling.behindText: Leaves a bubble where enemies and their shots crawl.

binding.name: Binding
binding.about: The word of the knot. What it holds stays held.
binding.frontText: Holds the enemies it hits in place.
binding.behindText: Leaves a snare for the next enemy to cross.
binding.monsterText: Its blows root you to the spot.

piercing.name: Piercing
piercing.about: The word of the point. Nothing stands in its way.
piercing.frontText: Goes through everything in its path.
piercing.behindText: A lance of light strikes down its line a moment later.
piercing.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls to reach you.

bleeding.name: Bleeding
bleeding.about: The word of the open wound. It does not close.
bleeding.frontText: Makes enemies bleed, worse while they move.
bleeding.behindText: Leaves thorns that cut whatever walks through.

reaping.name: Reaping
reaping.about: The word of the harvest. What falls is gathered in.
reaping.frontText: Kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns.
reaping.behindText: Kills raise a spirit that fights for you for a while.

culling.name: Culling
culling.about: The word of the end. The weak are taken.
culling.frontText: Enemies left nearly dead by its hit die outright.
culling.behindText: Leaves a reaper's mark that culls the first weak enemy to cross it.
culling.monsterText: Hits much harder when you are low.

surging.name: Surging
surging.about: The word of the swell. It gathers, then breaks.
surging.frontText: Every third use releases a shockwave round you.
surging.monsterText: Sends out a shockwave every few seconds.

plundering.name: Plundering
plundering.about: The word of the taking. What is theirs is yours.
plundering.frontText: Kills drop more gold, and sometimes an extra item.
plundering.behindText: Gold bursts from kills and flies to you.
plundering.monsterText: Each blow steals some of your gold, dropped when it dies.

mirroring.name: Mirroring
mirroring.about: The word of the reflection. Two of you, where there was one.
mirroring.frontText: A reflection of you makes the same attack beside you, weaker.
mirroring.behindText: Leaves a mirror that repeats your next attack from where you stood.
mirroring.monsterText: Sends part of the harm you do it back at you.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.frontText: A heavy fire hit. The blast leaves a pool of molten ground.
eruption.behindText: Hits build heat. At full heat the next hit erupts.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.frontText: A heavy cold hit that shoves enemies back and freezes the ones it stops.
avalanche.behindText: Every hit on a chilled enemy hits harder.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.frontText: One big bolt instead of arcs. It stuns.
thunder.behindText: Every few hits, a thunderclap bursts around you.

blight.name: Blight
blight.frontText: The hit is not weakened, and poison bites harder the lower the enemy's life.
blight.behindText: Poisoned enemies take more damage from everything.

scald.name: Scald
scald.frontText: A burning enemy that gets chilled, or a chilled one set burning, cracks for a burst of damage.
scald.behindText: Fire meeting ice on the ground bursts into steam that hurts and hides.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.frontText: Burning jumps to nearby enemies the way lightning arcs.
wildfire.behindText: The burning ground throws sparks at enemies near it.

fumes.name: Fumes
fumes.frontText: Burning poisoned enemies give off a toxic cloud.
fumes.behindText: The poison cloud explodes when anything burning enters it.

hailstorm.name: Hailstorm
hailstorm.frontText: Arcs chill everything they touch. Frozen enemies pass arcs on further.
hailstorm.behindText: A storm of ice that slows and strikes.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.frontText: Chilled enemies lose life over time, and frozen ones twice as fast.
frostbite.behindText: The ice on the ground poisons what crosses it.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.frontText: Every enemy an arc touches is poisoned.
contagion.behindText: The poison cloud shocks whatever stands in it.

demolition.name: Demolition
demolition.frontText: Bigger explosions. Elites and bosses also explode once, at half life.
demolition.behindText: One huge rune, slow to go off.

powderkeg.name: Powderkeg
powderkeg.frontText: Burning enemies explode when killed, and the blast sets others burning.
powderkeg.behindText: The rune leaves burning ground when it goes off.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.frontText: Frozen enemies burst into shards that hit those around them.
shatter.behindText: The rune freezes what is near, then bursts.

chainreaction.name: Chain Reaction
chainreaction.frontText: An exploding enemy sends arcs to the nearest enemies. Those it kills explode too.
chainreaction.behindText: Runes are linked. One going off sets off the rest.

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.frontText: Poisoned enemies burst when killed, splashing their poison on those around.
rupture.behindText: The rune bursts into a poison cloud.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.frontText: Your poison heals you while it eats them.
siphon.behindText: Your poison heals you a little.

cauterize.name: Cauterize
cauterize.frontText: Killing a burning enemy heals you a chunk.
cauterize.behindText: Killing a burning enemy heals you a little.

forking.name: Forking
forking.frontText: Every hit arcs to a second enemy nearby.
forking.behindText: Every hit arcs to a second enemy nearby, weaker.

shiver.name: Shiver
shiver.frontText: Critical hits freeze the target for a moment.
shiver.behindText: Critical hits freeze the target for an instant.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.behindText: Stunned enemies take a little extra damage.

fervor.name: Fervor
fervor.frontText: Each kill makes you attack faster and burn hotter for a few seconds.
fervor.behindText: Each kill quickens you and your fire a little.

rimeward.name: Rime Ward
rimeward.frontText: Blocking a hit chills the attacker.
rimeward.behindText: Blocking a hit chills the attacker a little.

implode.name: Implode
implode.frontText: Drags enemies together, then the spot bursts.
implode.behindText: Drags enemies together a little, then a small burst.

power2.name: Power II
power2.about: Two Power, melded: Power at rank II.
power2.frontText: As Power, half as strong again.
power2.behindText: As of Power, half as strong again.

fire2.name: Flame II
fire2.about: Two Flame, melded: Flame at rank II.
fire2.frontText: As Flame, half as strong again.
fire2.behindText: As of Flame, half as strong again.

frost2.name: Frost II
frost2.about: Two Frost, melded: Frost at rank II.
frost2.frontText: As Frost, half as strong again.
frost2.behindText: As of Frost, half as strong again.

lightning2.name: Lightning II
lightning2.about: Two Lightning, melded: Lightning at rank II.
lightning2.frontText: As Lightning, half as strong again.
lightning2.behindText: As of Lightning, half as strong again.

poison2.name: Poison II
poison2.about: Two Poison, melded: Poison at rank II.
poison2.frontText: As Poison, half as strong again.
poison2.behindText: As of Venom, half as strong again.

strike.name: Strike
strike.desc: Hit one enemy in front of you.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Hold to spin: you cut everything around you again and again, and pass through enemies.

leap.name: Lunge
leap.desc: Dive at a spot, your sword out before you. Nothing can hit you as you go, and the point strikes where you land.

shot.name: Shot
shot.desc: Loose an arrow at one enemy.

volley.name: Volley
volley.desc: Loose arrows at the sky: they rain on the spot you point at for a few seconds.

trap.name: Trap
trap.desc: A quick roll that nothing can hit, and you leave a trap where you stood: it bursts when an enemy steps on it. Holds two charges.

wave.name: Wave
wave.desc: Swing the staff: a wide wave of force that passes through every enemy in its path.

orb.name: Orb
orb.desc: Slam the staff down: an orb appears where you point and sends out waves of force for a few seconds.

warp.name: Warp
warp.desc: Vanish and reappear at a spot, instantly, in a burst that hurts what stands there.

hellbolt.name: Hellfire Bolt
hellbolt.desc: Hurl a bolt of hellfire at one enemy. It burns, hard.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: Chains of smoke curse every enemy near you. The cursed smoulder, and when one dies every burn on it spreads to those near it.

smokestep.name: Smoke Step
smokestep.desc: Break into smoke and streak to a spot. Nothing can hit you, and whoever you pass through is cursed.

vialtoss.name: Vial Toss
vialtoss.desc: Lob a vial off your belt. It bursts where it lands, hurting everything near.

golem.name: Golem
golem.desc: Whistle your Golem out: it follows you and shoots its cannon at what it fights. Whistle again and hold: it charges its big shot, fired as you let go.

blastjump.name: Blast Jump
blastjump.desc: Slap a bomb down at your feet and ride the blast to a spot. Whatever is by you is blown away.

vpunch.name: Punch
vpunch.desc: A tap fills a green globe: the jab, the cross, the hook, the spinning elbow, as his combo comes to them.

vkick.name: Kick
vkick.desc: A hold fills an orange globe: the round kick, then the push kick.

vjump.name: Jump
vjump.desc: A swipe is his dodging jump. A swipe then a tap or a hold sets the globe in fire: the flying uppercut, the flying knee, the spinning jump kick.

rake.name: Claw Rake
rake.desc: Rake with one claw, then the other. What it tears is cursed.

damning.name: Damning
damning.desc: Tear up the floor: the ground erupts under every enemy near you that is cursed or burning, and every burn on it goes off at once.

demonstep.name: Smoke Step
demonstep.desc: Tear along the floor as smoke, raking and cursing whoever you pass through, and burst out where you stop.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: A wide chop: every enemy in its arc is struck.

axethrow.name: Axe Throw
axethrow.desc: Throw your axe: it flies through what it meets, and comes back to you, striking again.

chop.name: Leaping Chop
chop.desc: Leap at a spot and bring your axe down where you land. Nothing can hit you as you go.

smash.name: Smash
smash.desc: The maul brought down on a spot before you: what it strikes staggers back, and a second blow soon after stuns it.

quake.name: Earthquake
quake.desc: A full spin, then the maul brought down: the ground before you quakes, and what stands on it is stunned.

charge.name: Shoulder Charge
charge.desc: Charge at a spot, shoulder first, striking every enemy in your way. Nothing can hit you as you go.

ball.name: Ball
ball.desc: A ball flies at the enemy and bursts where it hits, hurting all round it.

spear.name: Spear
spear.desc: A spear flies where you point, through every enemy in its line.

beam.name: Beam
beam.desc: Hold: a beam burns toward where you point, through everything in its way. Sweep it about.

snare.name: Snare
snare.desc: Throw a snare where you point: what walks into it is held fast, then it bursts.

snipe.name: Snipe
snipe.desc: Draw and hold: the longer you hold, the harder the shot, and it goes through enemies.

rally.name: Rally
rally.desc: A call: your companions and allies near you attack faster and harder for a few seconds.

contraption.name: Contraption
contraption.desc: Throw down a little mortar. It sets itself up and lobs your vials at whatever comes near. Up to three at once.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.blurb: Up close and hard to kill.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.blurb: A demon inside. It wants out.
